age.evidence: Plasma was collected at 4, 8, and 18 months from non-tumor-bearing mice and from those that had developed tumors between 12 and 18 months.

sex.evidence: Here, we used the radiation-genetic mammary chimera model to examine the differential expression of 532 plasma proteins in BALB/c female mice between radiation exposure and experiment termination at 18 months.
